```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  <?pi-target processing instruction data?>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Leading comment explaining child nodes -->
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with <tags> & entities like &internal; ]]>&internal;
  </child>
  <sub:child id="2">Normal text content</sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book+)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "Academics Press">
  <!ENTITY % dtdAttr "ATTLIST book rating CDATA #IMPLIED">
  <!%dtdAttr;>
  <?catalog-info version="2.0"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://library.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment: Section 1 books -->
  <book rating="5">
    <title><![CDATA[Advanced XML & Parsing]]></title>
    <author>&pub;</author>
  </book>
  <?custom-pi data="reparse"?>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY baseEnt "Standard Item">
  <!ENTITY complexEnt "&baseEnt; - Deluxe Edition">
  <!ENTITY % paramMacro "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>">
  %paramMacro;
  <?inventory-log status="active"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:loc="http://inventory.org/location">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment -->
  <loc:warehouse shelf="A4">
    <![CDATA[ 
       Special handling required for items containing <>&'" 
    ]]>
    <item>&complexEnt;</item>
  </loc:warehouse>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY secTitle "Introduction">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY % extDecl "<!ENTITY secEnt '&secTitle; Subsection'>">
  %extDecl;
  <?doc-info author="Tester"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:custom="http://doc.org/custom">
  <!-- Multi-namespace and entity stress test -->
  <section custom:type="primary">
    <![CDATA[ 
       Section CDATA: &secEnt; inside CDATA remains literal.
    ]]>
    &secEnt;
  </section>
  <?custom-action execute="true"?>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (test*)>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY t1 "Test Alpha">
  <!ENTITY t2 "&t1; and Beta">
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ENTITY t3 '&t2; and Gamma'>">
  %p1;
  <?suite-meta run="nightly"?>
]>
<suite xmlns="http://suite.org/schema" xmlns:tr="http://suite.org/tr">
  <!-- Suite configuration wrapper -->
  <tr:test id="t-001">
    <![CDATA[
       CDATA containing arbitrary markup: <test attr="val"> &t3; </test>
    ]]>
    <test>&t3;</test>
  </tr:test>
</suite>
```
